==[[ToDo|Projects that require volunteers]]==
==Inactive projects==
*Translations of Lojban learning material
**into Hebrew
***[[gimste|gimste]] is being worked on by [[Adam|Adam]]. Here is a partial [[Hebrew gismu List|list]]
*The [[minilesson|minilesson]] should receive an answer key. Apparently, people have been sending in answers but the promised commented answer key does not exist yet.
*Chrestomathy - This is a collection of translated and original writings designed to show a wide sampling of a language. We will want to produce one of these for Lojban after the core language description books are written. We need translations of texts generally a bit longer than the typical effort (1000-10000 words), and as wide a variety of texts and styles, from as many different source languages as possible.
*[[User:And Rosta|And Rosta]] was essaying a translation of [[The Importance of Being Earnest|The Importance of Being Earnest]] as time permits, as a private/personal project. <nowiki>[Feel free to delete this entry if this page is supposed to be for only for collaborative projects.]</nowiki> (There are loads of other translations by others that haven't been listed here, &amp; I can't decide whether I should use my limited time to review that or to work on my own translation.)
*[[TintinLIleNoirePage42|Tintin - L'Île Noire, page 42]] - may be followed by a complete translation if allowed by the rights owner (still in discussion).
*New learning material: Please record yourself saying the [[xirli'u selsanga|xirli'u selsanga]] and post it to the yahoo file server. A list of recordings, which we all should be keeping updated .e'o, is at [[Multimedia|Multimedia]].
*'''la maikl.''' is inputting the original '''jbopemci''' from '''ziryroi''' (as his schedule permits), &amp; hopes to add revisions &amp;/or new versions, with commentary, in the fullness of time.
*[[pc|pc]] is working on the logic of the logical language in a desultory fashion.  The latest phases of this (going on a year old) are at [[logical language|Logical Language]] and [[Logic Language Draft 1.1]] and following. Comments are welcomed -- indeed encouraged, also questions directed toward further steps (use the Discussion tab).
*[[Lojban diphone speech synthesizer|Lojban diphone speech synthesizer]] - [[Xavier|Xavier]] is conducting this one. It is aiming to be a complete Lojban speech text-to-speech system. [[Candide Kemmler|Candide Kemmler]] has already recorded diphones, they reside at [http://www.lojban.com/cgi-bin/twiki/view/Files/SoundFiles]. The most time-consuming work that remains now is marking up the start, end and middle of the diphones in the corpus.
*[[Pierre Abbat|Pierre Abbat]] was working on ''valfendi'', a complete rewrite of the lexical analyzer and morphological validator for Lojban, including different options on which cmevla are valid and which fu'ivla have rafsi.
